world.bio: I am from Irbid, Jordan, and have lived in Yiwu for twelve years. I source household goods for buyers in Amman, Dubai, Muscat and Kuwait: kitchen racks, plastic storage, small hardware, seasonal items for Ramadan. I write Arabic and English, speak market Mandarin well enough to argue about a price, and know which Futian market booths will actually ship what they photograph. I run a small one-man office on the fourth floor of a building near the International Trade City.
skills_assets: Arabic (native), English (fluent), spoken Mandarin (market level, reads maybe 300 characters)
Twelve years of supplier contacts in Yiwu, Ningbo and Shenzhen; a notebook of about 140 factory contacts sorted by product
Quality inspection at factories: carton drop tests, colour matching, counting inner packs
Relationships with three freight forwarders to Aqaba and Jebel Ali
A rented desk and a small sample room in Futian district, about 20 square metres

projects.name: Ramadan 2027 kitchenware line
projects.text: Two Amman wholesalers want a 40-foot container of stackable food containers and folding drying racks for Ramadan 2027, which starts around 8 February. That means orders placed by mid-November and shipped by mid-December. I have three candidate factories in Taizhou and Cixi. Samples are due next week. The main problem is price: resin went up again and one factory wants 30 percent deposit.

projects.name: Muscat hotel linens
projects.text: A hotel group in Muscat asked about towels and bedsheets. I sent quotes in July, they went quiet. Not chasing until they reply twice.

projects.name: Family trip to Amman
projects.text: My father turns 70 on 3 December. All five siblings are trying to be there. I need to book flights for me, my wife Rana and Yusuf, and decide whether Yusuf misses school. Looking at 28 Nov to 10 Dec.

notes.text: Container from Cixi arrived at Aqaba with 12 cartons crushed on one side. Forwarder says it was loaded badly, factory says it was the port. Photos taken, will claim 5 percent from the factory on the next order. Tired of this argument every time.
Football league match yesterday, we lost 4-3 to the Nigerian guys. My knee is bad. I should stop slide tackles at 43 but I won't.

Yusuf's Chinese dictation came back with 62. Last term it was 85. His teacher wrote in the notebook that he is rushing and the compositions have 'no content'. I looked at it and honestly I cannot tell what is wrong with his essay, my own Chinese is for markets, not for school. Rana reads even less. We do not know how to help him.
Monday and Thursday fasting. Good for the head. Skipped lunch with a Turkish supplier, he was a little hurt. Explained.
Resin price chart looks like a ski jump. If I quote Amman now I may lose money by November. Maybe quote with a validity of ten days only.
Father called on video. He is shrinking but his laugh is the same. He said do not buy expensive plane tickets, just come. I will buy them anyway. Mother is planning a mansaf for forty people.

Teacher meeting for Yusuf on Friday. She said it is common for children of foreign parents at this age, the spoken Chinese is good but writing does not catch up. She suggested one-on-one help, someone who can sit with him and read his compositions. Tutoring centres here charge 200 yuan an hour and use worksheets. He is ten, he gets bored with worksheets in five minutes.

National Day holiday, markets half empty. Went to the sample room alone and reorganised the shelves. Found a box of Eid lanterns from 2023 nobody bought. Perhaps sell on Taobao to the Arabic diaspora.
Rana wants a bigger flat. I said after the Ramadan season. She gave me the look.

messages.text:
Hamza: Khaled, can you do the folding rack in grey, not black? Customers say black looks cheap.
Me: Grey is possible, 3 percent more for the powder coat. I will send a sample Tuesday.
Hamza: Ok. And please keep the carton marks clear, last time customs took two days to read them.

Rana: Yusuf cried again over his homework. He says the characters are too many.
Me: I know. I told him we practise together after dinner.
Rana: You practise? You cannot even read what the teacher wrote.
Me: True. We will find someone.

Zhou: 老哈，价格我已经是最低了，树脂涨了我也难。
Me: 周老板，定金三成太高，二成行不行？
Zhou: 二成半，不能再少了。

Samer: Dad asked if you will bring the Yiwu tea set again.
Me: Tell him I will bring two. And tell Mama no more than forty guests this time.
Samer: Ha. Impossible.

Li: Next Saturday 8am, the pitch behind the school. Bring your boots, not sneakers.
Me: I will come. If my knee holds.

relations.about: Born in Yiwu, speaks Chinese with friends easily, reads and writes like a child two years behind. Likes football and drawing monsters.
From Amman, handles the household and the money transfers home.
Amman wholesaler, my biggest buyer, pays late but pays.

constraints: Cannot travel for factory visits between 15 Nov and 15 Dec
Does not pay through personal accounts of factory owners
Prays at work, needs a quiet half hour at midday
Prefers evening meetings because fasting days leave low energy by 4 pm
sensitive: Margin is thin: about 4 percent on Ramadan orders after freight claims
Savings are partly tied in unsold stock worth about 90,000 yuan
Worried that Yusuf is losing his connection to both Arabic reading and Chinese school

disclosure_policy.t0_public: Jordanian trader in Yiwu, sources household goods for the Gulf, Arabic and English.
disclosure_policy.t1_after_signal: Family situation in general terms, including that his son is ten and has trouble with Chinese writing; rough order seasons and schedule.
disclosure_policy.t2_after_trust: Specific business margins, stock levels and money worries.
